= Form and file upload processing

Libraries for parsing multipart form data and handling file uploads in Node.js.

* https://github.com/pillarjs/multiparty[multiparty]
* https://github.com/richardgirges/express-fileupload[express-fileupload]
* https://github.com/mscdex/busboy[busboy]
* https://github.com/node-formidable/formidable[formidable]
* https://github.com/expressjs/multer[multer]
